# Signal design library (signal-design)

> A flat, square, monochrome design library for Tailwind CSS v4 or plain CSS, with a small attribute-driven JS module and optional Chart.js charts. Install from GitHub: `pnpm add github:Medalink/signal-design`. Square corners, no shadows or gradients, color only for status, tokens only, SF Pro text with Source Code Pro for code.

Start with AGENTS.md: it is the contract (install, hard rules, which parts to use, accessibility duties, how to check your work). Then copy real markup from ai/components.json instead of inventing it.

## Guide

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install, rules, patterns, accessibility, checking
- [README.md](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/README.md): full human documentation

## Reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the guide plus every component's HTML in one file
- [ai/components.json](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/ai/components.json): every block with classes, attributes, HTML, required JS
- [ai/tokens.json](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/ai/tokens.json): every token per theme (ink, graphite, paper) with contrast ratios
- [src/js/index.d.ts](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/src/js/index.d.ts): JS API types
- [src/js/charts/index.d.ts](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/src/js/charts/index.d.ts): charts API types

## Optional

- [vscode/html-data.json](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/vscode/html-data.json): editor completions for data-sd-* attributes
- [vscode/css-data.json](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/vscode/css-data.json): editor completions for --sd-* tokens
- [skills/signal-design/SKILL.md](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/skills/signal-design/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill
